title: blemees-workflow issue-type directory
description: Schema for the shared `issue-types.json` file. Provides editor / IDE feedback; cross-reference checks (each process's `issue_types` entries resolve here) run in `workflow validate`.

types.description: Map of type-id → type definition. Type ids are short framework-canonical names (bug, feature, hotfix, chore, spike, experiment, pr).

description.description: Prose description of what this type means. Often references the work-types catalog.

github_issue_type.description: Exact GitHub Issue Type name to apply via `gh issue create --type`. Optional. Forbidden when `github_entity` is `pull_request` (PRs are not a native GitHub Issue Type).

github_issue_type_color.description: Color hint for `setup-github --setup-org`. GitHub accepts these eight named colors.

github_entity.description: Which GitHub entity this type creates. `issue` is default; `pull_request` is the special `pr` type. Drives whether the CLI dispatches `gh issue create` or `gh pr create`.
